meta.title: Arcadia I
meta.description: We support each other in a forgotten world and make our way ahead together.

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector outskirts.
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector outskirts.

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector outskirts.

units.rawText: Professor, such a number of Entropics is tough enough to handle. There's more converging on this location, too.
units.displayText: Professor, such a number of Entropics is tough enough to handle. There's more converging on this location, too.

spans.text: Professor, such a number of Entropics is tough enough to handle. There's more converging on this location, too.

units.rawText: This isn't something triple wages can just cover.
units.displayText: This isn't something triple wages can just cover.

spans.text: This isn't something triple wages can just cover.

units.rawText: ...Simply defending will get us nowhere. We will be relegated to nothing but prey if we do not move out.
units.displayText: ...Simply defending will get us nowhere. We will be relegated to nothing but prey if we do not move out.

spans.text: ...Simply defending will get us nowhere. We will be relegated to nothing but prey if we do not move out.

units.rawText: Havoc, could you please delay the Entropics as much as you can? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, we'll send help immediately.
units.displayText: Havoc, could you please delay the Entropics as much as you can? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, we'll send help immediately.

spans.text: Havoc, could you please delay the Entropics as much as you can? Once we rescue Antonina and Professor Irida, we'll send help immediately.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll leave Boss with you. Make sure you put in a word for me that she really needs to give me a good long holiday after this job.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll leave Boss with you. Make sure you put in a word for me that she really needs to give me a good long holiday after this job.

spans.text: Alright, I'll leave Boss with you. Make sure you put in a word for me that she really needs to give me a good long holiday after this job.

units.rawText: Havoc ends the call, letting out a sigh.
units.displayText: Havoc ends the call, letting out a sigh.

spans.text: Havoc ends the call, letting out a sigh.

units.rawText: Man... And here I thought the job here at the Guardians was too much, and that I'd have an easier time slacking off at the Oasis. Now here I am, doing stuff even more insane than what Boss asked of me.
units.displayText: Man... And here I thought the job here at the Guardians was too much, and that I'd have an easier time slacking off at the Oasis. Now here I am, doing stuff even more insane than what Boss asked of me.

spans.text: Man... And here I thought the job here at the Guardians was too much, and that I'd have an easier time slacking off at the Oasis. Now here I am, doing stuff even more insane than what Boss asked of me.

units.rawText: I was expecting some rest after the battle for Arcadia, but I got dragged into holding the Neural Cloud Sector together right after...
units.displayText: I was expecting some rest after the battle for Arcadia, but I got dragged into holding the Neural Cloud Sector together right after...

spans.text: I was expecting some rest after the battle for Arcadia, but I got dragged into holding the Neural Cloud Sector together right after...

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll picks up her piledriver, turning back towards the battlefield before De Lacey grabs her arm.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll picks up her piledriver, turning back towards the battlefield before De Lacey grabs her arm.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll picks up her piledriver, turning back towards the battlefield before De Lacey grabs her arm.

units.rawText: Havi, sit down for a little, let me take a look at you...
units.displayText: Havi, sit down for a little, let me take a look at you...

spans.text: Havi, sit down for a little, let me take a look at you...

units.rawText: Woah... This is some serious damage, what happened? What about Hacchy and the others?
units.displayText: Woah... This is some serious damage, what happened? What about Hacchy and the others?

spans.text: Woah... This is some serious damage, what happened? What about Hacchy and the others?

units.rawText: Waaa... that hurts! There were... way more Entropics here than we imagined. Even the undergrounds are filled with Entropy liquid.
units.displayText: Waaa... that hurts! There were... way more Entropics here than we imagined. Even the undergrounds are filled with Entropy liquid.

spans.text: Waaa... that hurts! There were... way more Entropics here than we imagined. Even the undergrounds are filled with Entropy liquid.

units.rawText: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi wanted to sneak in, but they got a faceful of the purple stuff. Thank goodness the suppressors still work...
units.displayText: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi wanted to sneak in, but they got a faceful of the purple stuff. Thank goodness the suppressors still work...

spans.text: Hatsuchiri and Sueyoi wanted to sneak in, but they got a faceful of the purple stuff. Thank goodness the suppressors still work...

units.rawText: But I found another entry point, so I figured it was worth the risk... ouch! Be a bit gentler, De Lacey! I have pain circuits too, you know!
units.displayText: But I found another entry point, so I figured it was worth the risk... ouch! Be a bit gentler, De Lacey! I have pain circuits too, you know!

spans.text: But I found another entry point, so I figured it was worth the risk... ouch! Be a bit gentler, De Lacey! I have pain circuits too, you know!

units.rawText: Havoc waves her arms in protest as she dodges De Lacey's discontent look.
units.displayText: Havoc waves her arms in protest as she dodges De Lacey's discontent look.

spans.text: Havoc waves her arms in protest as she dodges De Lacey's discontent look.

units.rawText: And you better remember how this hurts! No wonder Hacchy made you come back here.
units.displayText: And you better remember how this hurts! No wonder Hacchy made you come back here.

spans.text: And you better remember how this hurts! No wonder Hacchy made you come back here.

units.rawText: I'm alright. I'm only second to Lind in how wacky my body is.
units.displayText: I'm alright. I'm only second to Lind in how wacky my body is.

spans.text: I'm alright. I'm only second to Lind in how wacky my body is.

units.rawText: Havoc squeezes her own face in a comical manner.
units.displayText: Havoc squeezes her own face in a comical manner.

spans.text: Havoc squeezes her own face in a comical manner.

units.rawText: Hehe, I'm the result of state-of-the-art human material sciences from a comfort and sturdiness standpoint.
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm the result of state-of-the-art human material sciences from a comfort and sturdiness standpoint.

spans.text: Hehe, I'm the result of state-of-the-art human material sciences from a comfort and sturdiness standpoint.

units.rawText: Want a squeeze?
units.displayText: Want a squeeze?

spans.text: Want a squeeze?

units.rawText: You know that's not what I mean. Havi, in the Wipe-off Incident, your neural cloud...
units.displayText: You know that's not what I mean. Havi, in the Wipe-off Incident, your neural cloud...

spans.text: You know that's not what I mean. Havi, in the Wipe-off Incident, your neural cloud...

units.rawText: I know... That's why I'm the best at keeping a work-life balance in the Guardians~
units.displayText: I know... That's why I'm the best at keeping a work-life balance in the Guardians~

spans.text: I know... That's why I'm the best at keeping a work-life balance in the Guardians~

units.rawText: No need to be so serious, De Lacey~ Relax, I just want everyone to get off work a bit earlier.
units.displayText: No need to be so serious, De Lacey~ Relax, I just want everyone to get off work a bit earlier.

spans.text: No need to be so serious, De Lacey~ Relax, I just want everyone to get off work a bit earlier.

units.rawText: Sigh... No wonder Linny and the others get upset at you.
units.displayText: Sigh... No wonder Linny and the others get upset at you.

spans.text: Sigh... No wonder Linny and the others get upset at you.

units.rawText: That's just her temper. Though I am getting a bit worried about them now. The Entropics over there stretch beyond the horizon, it feels like.
units.displayText: That's just her temper. Though I am getting a bit worried about them now. The Entropics over there stretch beyond the horizon, it feels like.

spans.text: That's just her temper. Though I am getting a bit worried about them now. The Entropics over there stretch beyond the horizon, it feels like.

units.rawText: Ok, ok, that'll do for the wounds. Let me handle the rest myself.
units.displayText: Ok, ok, that'll do for the wounds. Let me handle the rest myself.

spans.text: Ok, ok, that'll do for the wounds. Let me handle the rest myself.

units.rawText: Havi...
units.displayText: Havi...

spans.text: Havi...

units.rawText: I'll be fine. And if you don't go help Hatsuchiri out, she might not be able to wrangle Sueyoi and Lind, okay?
units.displayText: I'll be fine. And if you don't go help Hatsuchiri out, she might not be able to wrangle Sueyoi and Lind, okay?

spans.text: I'll be fine. And if you don't go help Hatsuchiri out, she might not be able to wrangle Sueyoi and Lind, okay?

units.rawText: Looking at the firmness in Havoc's eyes, De Lacey internalizes the grimness of the situation.
units.displayText: Looking at the firmness in Havoc's eyes, De Lacey internalizes the grimness of the situation.

spans.text: Looking at the firmness in Havoc's eyes, De Lacey internalizes the grimness of the situation.

units.rawText: I'll go have a look then. Be careful.
units.displayText: I'll go have a look then. Be careful.

spans.text: I'll go have a look then. Be careful.

units.rawText: You go first. I'll head off after I'm done healing.
units.displayText: You go first. I'll head off after I'm done healing.

spans.text: You go first. I'll head off after I'm done healing.

units.rawText: After visually making sure that De Lacey had left, Havoc lets out a held breath, sprawling out on the ground.
units.displayText: After visually making sure that De Lacey had left, Havoc lets out a held breath, sprawling out on the ground.

spans.text: After visually making sure that De Lacey had left, Havoc lets out a held breath, sprawling out on the ground.

units.rawText: Ahhhh~ it hurts! Why does this healing program hurt like this!
units.displayText: Ahhhh~ it hurts! Why does this healing program hurt like this!

spans.text: Ahhhh~ it hurts! Why does this healing program hurt like this!

units.rawText: I'm not sticking it out next time, no way... Eeeeee, I would've brought my blankie if I had known.
units.displayText: I'm not sticking it out next time, no way... Eeeeee, I would've brought my blankie if I had known.

spans.text: I'm not sticking it out next time, no way... Eeeeee, I would've brought my blankie if I had known.

units.rawText: Havoc complains as she lies on the ground, healing herself.
units.displayText: Havoc complains as she lies on the ground, healing herself.

spans.text: Havoc complains as she lies on the ground, healing herself.

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector, huh... Brings back memories...
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector, huh... Brings back memories...

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector, huh... Brings back memories...

units.rawText: If it wasn't for Project Neural Cloud, chances are I'd still be...
units.displayText: If it wasn't for Project Neural Cloud, chances are I'd still be...

spans.text: If it wasn't for Project Neural Cloud, chances are I'd still be...

units.rawText: Take note of the condition of every piece of material on you and record it. You have 60000 seconds.
units.displayText: Take note of the condition of every piece of material on you and record it. You have 60000 seconds.

spans.text: Take note of the condition of every piece of material on you and record it. You have 60000 seconds.

units.rawText: BEEP—
units.displayText: BEEP—

spans.text: BEEP—

units.rawText: Bodily damage? It's alright, we can fix it up with new materials. Neural damage? A few repairs and they'll be good with self-repairs. That's how they're designed, right?
units.displayText: Bodily damage? It's alright, we can fix it up with new materials. Neural damage? A few repairs and they'll be good with self-repairs. That's how they're designed, right?

spans.text: Bodily damage? It's alright, we can fix it up with new materials. Neural damage? A few repairs and they'll be good with self-repairs. That's how they're designed, right?

units.rawText: Can't be fixed? What do you mean? So this one's already useless... Tsk, there's still a few materials to test. Out of this batch, the only one that can still move is that Doll called Havoc, right?
units.displayText: Can't be fixed? What do you mean? So this one's already useless... Tsk, there's still a few materials to test. Out of this batch, the only one that can still move is that Doll called Havoc, right?

spans.text: Can't be fixed? What do you mean? So this one's already useless... Tsk, there's still a few materials to test. Out of this batch, the only one that can still move is that Doll called Havoc, right?

units.rawText: Since they're all useless, let's use them for demolition tests. Let's have the one called Havoc handle it.
units.displayText: Since they're all useless, let's use them for demolition tests. Let's have the one called Havoc handle it.

spans.text: Since they're all useless, let's use them for demolition tests. Let's have the one called Havoc handle it.

units.rawText: BEEEEEEEEP—The piercing ringtone drags Havoc out of her memories.
units.displayText: BEEEEEEEEP—The piercing ringtone drags Havoc out of her memories.

spans.text: BEEEEEEEEP—The piercing ringtone drags Havoc out of her memories.

units.rawText: Woah! A call?! I'm not slacking, I swear!
units.displayText: Woah! A call?! I'm not slacking, I swear!

spans.text: Woah! A call?! I'm not slacking, I swear!

units.rawText: Havoc! Leave, quickly! There's something off!
units.displayText: Havoc! Leave, quickly! There's something off!

spans.text: Havoc! Leave, quickly! There's something off!

units.rawText: Lind?!
units.displayText: Lind?!

spans.text: Lind?!

units.rawText: Havi, the Entropic modus operandi here suddenly changed.
units.displayText: Havi, the Entropic modus operandi here suddenly changed.

spans.text: Havi, the Entropic modus operandi here suddenly changed.

units.rawText: We're being surrounded by them.
units.displayText: We're being surrounded by them.

spans.text: We're being surrounded by them.

units.rawText: I'll come help right now!
units.displayText: I'll come help right now!

spans.text: I'll come help right now!

units.rawText: Havoc, do not come here!
units.displayText: Havoc, do not come here!

spans.text: Havoc, do not come here!

units.rawText: We're already surrounded, you'd only be letting yourself fall into hot water!
units.displayText: We're already surrounded, you'd only be letting yourself fall into hot water!

spans.text: We're already surrounded, you'd only be letting yourself fall into hot water!

units.rawText: B-But...
units.displayText: B-But...

spans.text: B-But...

units.rawText: Havoc, go find reinforcements. We'll hold out until then.
units.displayText: Havoc, go find reinforcements. We'll hold out until then.

spans.text: Havoc, go find reinforcements. We'll hold out until then.

units.rawText: BEEP—
units.displayText: BEEP—

spans.text: BEEP—

units.rawText: The call is cut off in a brusque manner. It went without saying that Lind and the others were in significant trouble.
units.displayText: The call is cut off in a brusque manner. It went without saying that Lind and the others were in significant trouble.

spans.text: The call is cut off in a brusque manner. It went without saying that Lind and the others were in significant trouble.

units.rawText: Reinforcements... the closest reinforcements...
units.displayText: Reinforcements... the closest reinforcements...

spans.text: Reinforcements... the closest reinforcements...

units.rawText: Even if Shale and Bonneville can make it over, Lind and the others...
units.displayText: Even if Shale and Bonneville can make it over, Lind and the others...

spans.text: Even if Shale and Bonneville can make it over, Lind and the others...

units.rawText: Unless...
units.displayText: Unless...

spans.text: Unless...

units.rawText: Havoc stares intently at the tactical map, sighing helplessly.
units.displayText: Havoc stares intently at the tactical map, sighing helplessly.

spans.text: Havoc stares intently at the tactical map, sighing helplessly.

units.rawText: So that's the only thing left...
units.displayText: So that's the only thing left...

spans.text: So that's the only thing left...

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector, by the upload equipment.

units.rawText: Huff... huff... huff...
units.displayText: Huff... huff... huff...

spans.text: Huff... huff... huff...

units.rawText: Linny, let me help heal you... Ah...
units.displayText: Linny, let me help heal you... Ah...

spans.text: Linny, let me help heal you... Ah...

units.rawText: A sharp tentacle glides across De Lacey's back as light purple operands emit from her body.
units.displayText: A sharp tentacle glides across De Lacey's back as light purple operands emit from her body.

spans.text: A sharp tentacle glides across De Lacey's back as light purple operands emit from her body.

units.rawText: Out of my way!
units.displayText: Out of my way!

spans.text: Out of my way!

units.rawText: Sueyoi waves the spear in his hand, driving several Entropics back. The Entropics' tentacles latch onto his body.
units.displayText: Sueyoi waves the spear in his hand, driving several Entropics back. The Entropics' tentacles latch onto his body.

spans.text: Sueyoi waves the spear in his hand, driving several Entropics back. The Entropics' tentacles latch onto his body.

units.rawText: Back, Sueyoi!
units.displayText: Back, Sueyoi!

spans.text: Back, Sueyoi!

units.rawText: Don't need you to tell me!
units.displayText: Don't need you to tell me!

spans.text: Don't need you to tell me!

units.rawText: After but a few minutes, the four Guardians are covered in wounds.
units.displayText: After but a few minutes, the four Guardians are covered in wounds.

spans.text: After but a few minutes, the four Guardians are covered in wounds.

units.rawText: Hatsuchiri, this can't continue! We'll be done for before the reinforcements are here.
units.displayText: Hatsuchiri, this can't continue! We'll be done for before the reinforcements are here.

spans.text: Hatsuchiri, this can't continue! We'll be done for before the reinforcements are here.

units.rawText: Us two... I think we can get them out of here.
units.displayText: Us two... I think we can get them out of here.

spans.text: Us two... I think we can get them out of here.

units.rawText: We can't!
units.displayText: We can't!

spans.text: We can't!

units.rawText: It's a no from me too... I can still fight.
units.displayText: It's a no from me too... I can still fight.

spans.text: It's a no from me too... I can still fight.

units.rawText: And that slacker'll bring reinforcements, I'm sure of it.
units.displayText: And that slacker'll bring reinforcements, I'm sure of it.

spans.text: And that slacker'll bring reinforcements, I'm sure of it.

units.rawText: Wow! I'm going to shed a tear, with how much Lind trusts me.
units.displayText: Wow! I'm going to shed a tear, with how much Lind trusts me.

spans.text: Wow! I'm going to shed a tear, with how much Lind trusts me.

units.rawText: Havoc?!
units.displayText: Havoc?!

spans.text: Havoc?!

units.rawText: Through the Entropic mass, Lind and the others spot a speck of green.
units.displayText: Through the Entropic mass, Lind and the others spot a speck of green.

spans.text: Through the Entropic mass, Lind and the others spot a speck of green.

units.rawText: What they struggle to believe, however, is that Havoc came here by herself.
units.displayText: What they struggle to believe, however, is that Havoc came here by herself.

spans.text: What they struggle to believe, however, is that Havoc came here by herself.

units.rawText: <size=60>Idiot! What are you doing here?</size>
units.displayText: Idiot! What are you doing here?

spans.text: Idiot! What are you doing here?

units.rawText: <size=60>La la la~ I can't hear what you're saying~</size>
units.displayText: La la la~ I can't hear what you're saying~

spans.text: La la la~ I can't hear what you're saying~

units.rawText: <size=60>Don't worry~ I know what to do~</size>
units.displayText: Don't worry~ I know what to do~

spans.text: Don't worry~ I know what to do~

units.rawText: She cups her hands like a megaphone, somewhat jokingly yelling at Lind and the others.
units.displayText: She cups her hands like a megaphone, somewhat jokingly yelling at Lind and the others.

spans.text: She cups her hands like a megaphone, somewhat jokingly yelling at Lind and the others.

units.rawText: The nearby Entropics pay no mind to Havoc, ceaselessly maintaining the encirclement.
units.displayText: The nearby Entropics pay no mind to Havoc, ceaselessly maintaining the encirclement.

spans.text: The nearby Entropics pay no mind to Havoc, ceaselessly maintaining the encirclement.

units.rawText: Still not attacking me... Bound to be a High Order Entropic in command here.
units.displayText: Still not attacking me... Bound to be a High Order Entropic in command here.

spans.text: Still not attacking me... Bound to be a High Order Entropic in command here.

units.rawText: How long are you going to hide for, jellyfish?
units.displayText: How long are you going to hide for, jellyfish?

spans.text: How long are you going to hide for, jellyfish?

units.rawText: The air falls silent. The Entropics do not respond to Havoc's question.
units.displayText: The air falls silent. The Entropics do not respond to Havoc's question.

spans.text: The air falls silent. The Entropics do not respond to Havoc's question.

units.rawText: Right... I see how it is.
units.displayText: Right... I see how it is.

spans.text: Right... I see how it is.

units.rawText: She produces a purple core, holding it high.
units.displayText: She produces a purple core, holding it high.

spans.text: She produces a purple core, holding it high.

units.rawText: <color=red>This should get a response from you, right?</color>
units.displayText: This should get a response from you, right?

spans.text: This should get a response from you, right?

units.rawText: I must confess I am surprised.
units.displayText: I must confess I am surprised.

spans.text: I must confess I am surprised.

units.rawText: Squelch—
units.displayText: Squelch—

spans.text: Squelch—

units.rawText: Entropy liquid seeps out of crevices in the earth as the puddle's surface is disrupted by a wave of ripples.
units.displayText: Entropy liquid seeps out of crevices in the earth as the puddle's surface is disrupted by a wave of ripples.

spans.text: Entropy liquid seeps out of crevices in the earth as the puddle's surface is disrupted by a wave of ripples.

units.rawText: From the middle of the liquid an elegant High Order Entropic slowly emerges, considering Havoc with some anger.
units.displayText: From the middle of the liquid an elegant High Order Entropic slowly emerges, considering Havoc with some anger.

spans.text: From the middle of the liquid an elegant High Order Entropic slowly emerges, considering Havoc with some anger.

units.rawText: I had thought she would be on Lind... Why is she in your hands?
units.displayText: I had thought she would be on Lind... Why is she in your hands?

spans.text: I had thought she would be on Lind... Why is she in your hands?

units.rawText: The Professor was right, you're not the same kind of Entropic as Caina. You are not as powerful as the other High Orders, but your abilities are more complicated, and you're more intelligent... You've got that obsession with Lind on top of that.
units.displayText: The Professor was right, you're not the same kind of Entropic as Caina. You are not as powerful as the other High Orders, but your abilities are more complicated, and you're more intelligent... You've got that obsession with Lind on top of that.

spans.text: The Professor was right, you're not the same kind of Entropic as Caina. You are not as powerful as the other High Orders, but your abilities are more complicated, and you're more intelligent... You've got that obsession with Lind on top of that.

units.rawText: To suppress Lind's Entropization, we removed the core in her some time ago.
units.displayText: To suppress Lind's Entropization, we removed the core in her some time ago.

spans.text: To suppress Lind's Entropization, we removed the core in her some time ago.

units.rawText: We thought it would only be good for research, but it turned out to be useful here.
units.displayText: We thought it would only be good for research, but it turned out to be useful here.

spans.text: We thought it would only be good for research, but it turned out to be useful here.

units.rawText: Hand over Antenora's core, Doll.
units.displayText: Hand over Antenora's core, Doll.

spans.text: Hand over Antenora's core, Doll.

units.rawText: Let my friends go first!
units.displayText: Let my friends go first!

spans.text: Let my friends go first!

units.rawText: Ptolemaea raises her staff high as a respond to Havoc's taunting.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea raises her staff high as a respond to Havoc's taunting.

spans.text: Ptolemaea raises her staff high as a respond to Havoc's taunting.

units.rawText: For me to lose my composure because of Antenora's Entropic core... If I simply kill you...
units.displayText: For me to lose my composure because of Antenora's Entropic core... If I simply kill you...

spans.text: For me to lose my composure because of Antenora's Entropic core... If I simply kill you...

units.rawText: I shall have both your companions and Antenora's core.
units.displayText: I shall have both your companions and Antenora's core.

spans.text: I shall have both your companions and Antenora's core.

units.rawText: Ye, dancer of no renown, I warn you once more... Hand over Antenora's core and leave. I have no interest in you.
units.displayText: Ye, dancer of no renown, I warn you once more... Hand over Antenora's core and leave. I have no interest in you.

spans.text: Ye, dancer of no renown, I warn you once more... Hand over Antenora's core and leave. I have no interest in you.

units.rawText: Unlucky for you, then! I've got a lot I intend to settle with you.
units.displayText: Unlucky for you, then! I've got a lot I intend to settle with you.

spans.text: Unlucky for you, then! I've got a lot I intend to settle with you.

units.rawText: Whether it's for Lind and the others, the Professor's mission, or when you swindled me that time.
units.displayText: Whether it's for Lind and the others, the Professor's mission, or when you swindled me that time.

spans.text: Whether it's for Lind and the others, the Professor's mission, or when you swindled me that time.

units.rawText: I'm not leaving anytime soon!
units.displayText: I'm not leaving anytime soon!

spans.text: I'm not leaving anytime soon!

units.rawText: Shield in one hand and piledriver in the other, Havoc aims her weapon's sharp tip at Ptolemaea's chest.
units.displayText: Shield in one hand and piledriver in the other, Havoc aims her weapon's sharp tip at Ptolemaea's chest.

spans.text: Shield in one hand and piledriver in the other, Havoc aims her weapon's sharp tip at Ptolemaea's chest.

units.rawText: Come on, you rotten jellyfish!
units.displayText: Come on, you rotten jellyfish!

spans.text: Come on, you rotten jellyfish!
